data.name: Prismachines
data.detailed_description:
Prismachines is a stationary horde-survival autobattler where your team-building does all the fighting for you. You don't dodge bullets or mash buttons; you draft units, equip them with game-breaking items, and watch the readable chaos unfold.

Build The Ultimate Machine

Your shapes are empty platforms; the items do everything. Discover deep horizontal synergy by chaining trigger-based effects together.

  • Create Chain Reactions: Equip items so a basic attack triggers a lightning chain, which applies marks, which detonate into massive AoE explosions.

  • Risk vs. Reward: Buy Tier 6 "Degenerate" items that offer immense power but cripple your unit by setting their armor to zero or slashing their max HP.

Positioning is Everything

  • Draft Your Squad: Build a team of up to 5 unique units, from the rapid-fire Triangle to the ultra-durable Rectangle.

  • Grid Placement: Place them strategically to intercept swarms of enemies spawning from all four borders. Once combat starts, your preparation is your only weapon.

Survive The Swarm

  • Escalating Waves: Test your builds against 30 rounds of unique enemy compositions and elite variants.

  • Massive Bosses: Every 6 rounds, face off against screen-dominating bosses, culminating in "The Convergence"—a multi-phase nightmare with 60x base health.

data.short_description: Prismachines is a roguelike, stationary, horde-survival, autobattler. Draft a team of geometric shapes, equip them with game-breaking trigger items, and position them on the grid. Watch your automated engine of destruction unleash screen-clearing chain reactions to survive 20 escalating waves.
